title: Cobblemon Stargazing
description: A Cobblemon modpack to play under the stars!
body:
**This modpack is a work in progress! It will be _slowly_ updated overtime, but do not expect this to be properly playable or have anything of note right now.**


# Welcome to Cobblemon Stargazing!

This modpack focuses mostly on Cobblemon, while also having some other tid-bits to hopefully make your adventures more enjoyable!

Here are the most important tid-bits to mention..
### Origins
  
Over time, custom Origins will be added to this modpack, mostly with a focus on astrological signs, the zodiacs, or random what-nots.

### The Cobblemon Stuff
- Raid Dens
- Cobbleloots
- Casino Rocket
- Cobbled Gacha
- Cobblemon: Mega Showdown
- Cobblemon Alphas
- Cobblenav
- Cobblemon Cards
